title: Max Davis's first skeptical reaction to Josiah's messages

tellings.quote: trying to get something from me it actually made her cry cuz I'm a skeptic so that's how it began

plain: A man named Max Davis says that when messages first came from Josiah, a boy featured in a documentary about children said to read minds, his doubt was so strong it made someone cry. He tells it as his own memory and calls himself a skeptic. He presents it as how his involvement began, before he came to see things differently.
